findings.title: Review exposed TCP 445 (SMB port; Nmap service: microsoft-ds)
findings.description: TCP 445 is conventionally used by SMB; verify network restrictions, patching and share permissions. Nmap identified the service as 'microsoft-ds'.
findings.evidence: Host: 192.0.2.10; port: 445/tcp; service: microsoft-ds; product/version: not identified
findings.recommendation: Confirm business need, restrict source networks, harden configuration and validate patch level.
findings.confidence: Exposure indicator from the scan's vantage point; not proof of vulnerability

note: Open ports are exposure observations, not confirmed vulnerabilities. Validate service context manually.
